concerns.text: T009.6b and T030.1 attempt to map external reader-response data to the local corpus via SHA-256 hash of text. This creates a circular dependency: the external dataset (T009.6) does not contain the specific Project Gutenberg stories generated in T007.1, so the hash match will fail. T032 (aggregation) depends on T030.1's output, which will be empty. The producer (T007.1 generating local stories) and consumer (T009.6b mapping external data) are disconnected; a new task to generate local reader-response data (simulated or collected) is required before T032 can run.

T025 (matching validation) is marked as failed/rejected and lacks an implementation. T043 (sensitivity analysis) explicitly depends on T025's output (`matching_results.json` with `threshold_used` field). Without T025 producing this artifact, T043 cannot execute the threshold sweep required by FR-006. The consumer (T043) is scheduled before the producer (T025) is functional.

T040 (visualization) is marked as failed/rejected. T041 (analysis output) and T051 (end-to-end test) depend on the existence of `data/artifacts/regression_plot.png` generated by T040. The consumer tasks (T041, T051) are scheduled to run before the producer (T040) is implemented, violating the artifact-flow dependency.

Phase 7 tasks (T055-T058) depend on `data/raw/reflections.csv` containing `reflection_text`. No task exists in the plan to generate or fetch this specific input file (T009.6 only fetches scores, not text). The consumer tasks (T056, T057) are scheduled before the producer (data collection of reflections) exists, making the phase unexecutable.

T007.1b (mapping gold-standard IDs) depends on T007.1 (fetching external gold-standard data). However, the spec (SC-001) requires a correlation against a manually annotated subset of the *local* corpus. External datasets rarely contain the exact text of Project Gutenberg stories to allow SHA-256 matching. If T007.1b yields zero matches, T010 (validation test) cannot run. A task to manually annotate a local subset (producer) is missing before T010 (consumer).
